v: na॰ kukyate AdIyate kuka--AdAne--umak ni॰ mum । kASmIrAdideSaje svanAmaKyAte 1 ganDadravyaBede । deSaBedaviSezajAtasya tasya lakzaRAdi BAvaprakASe darSitaM yaTA“kASmIradeSaje kzetre kuNkamaM yadBavedDi tat । sUkzmakeSaramAraktaM padmaganDi taduttamam । vAhlIkadeSasaMjAtaM kuNkumaM pARqurammatam । ketakIganDayuktantanmaDyamaM sUkzmakeSaram । kuNkumaM pArasIke yanmaDuganDi tadIritam । IzatpARquravarRaM yadaDamaM sTUlakeSaram । kuNkamaM kawukaM snigDaM SirorugvraRajantujit । tiktaM vamiharaM varRyaM vyaNgadozaSramApaham”
m: कुङ्कुम n. saffron (Crocus sativus, the plant and the pollen of the flowers), Suśr.; Ragh.; Bhartṛ. &c.

k.v: तमालपत्रतिलकचित्रकाणि विशेषकम्. द्वितीयं च तुरीयं च न स्त्रियामथ कुङ्कुमम्.।

m: कुङ्कुम—पङ्क m. saffron used as an unguent, Bhartṛ.
कुङ्कुम—रेणु f. the pollen of saffron.
